description: This file implements the 'git read-tree' command, which reads a tree object into the index and optionally updates the working directory. It includes functions for parsing tree objects, handling command-line options, and performing merge and reset operations within the context of the Git version control system.

methods.name: int list_tree(struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Reads a tree object identified by oid, parses it, and adds it to the trees array if within limit.

methods.name: int index_output_cb(const struct option * opt UNUSED,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Callback for handling the --index-output option, sets the alternate index output file.

methods.name: int exclude_per_directory_cb(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Callback for handling --exclude-per-directory option, checks validity and arguments.

methods.name: void debug_stage(const char * label,const struct cache_entry * ce,struct unpack_trees_options * o)
methods.description: Prints debugging information for a cache entry or conflict.

methods.name: int debug_merge(const struct cache_entry * const * stages,struct unpack_trees_options * o)
methods.description: Outputs debug information for a merge of multiple stages.

methods.name: int git_read_tree_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Handles the 'submodule.recurse' config variable, delegates to default config handling.

methods.name: int cmd_read_tree(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * cmd_prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git read-tree' command, parsing options, handling trees, and updating the index and working directory accordingly.
